title: Pasting the internal scalar tensor counit square
statement: Under normalized scalar data, an internal tensorator, its compatible section conjugate and an ordinary scalar-unit tensor formula, the two localization-counit paths agree on section images of internal flat-term K-flat complexes. Compare their separate evaluations against the explicit internal scalar-total path and cancel the input.
